name: input
title: Input
description: An animated text input for React and shadcn, with leading and trailing addons and an error state.

meta.details: A Base UI text input whose focus is the border alone. An error shakes it once, 6px, then the field's message opens with a height spring. Leading and trailing addons.

docs: Import Input from components/eased/input/input; wrap it in Field for a label and messages. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
